Hi all,

Sharing a short technical note ahead of tomorrow’s kickoff: key pieces the runtime team will want to validate during the evaluation window (attached as runtime-topology-v1.png):
- Inbound/outbound ports: 443 (control plane), 10250/10255 (metrics/health), 2379-2380 (etcd) if you’re running a managed control plane, plus UDP for peering where applicable.
- Prefixes: we recommend reserving a /28 for the control-plane endpoints and a /24 for worker egress to avoid overlap with on-prem ranges.
- VPN expectations: we support both policy and route-based tunnels; BGP is optional but recommended for multi-AZ resilience.
- KMS: if you choose customer-managed keys we’ll need the key ARN and a test key (or an access window to your KMS) for initial onboarding.
- Logs/audit: we will stream audit logs to your collector; please confirm SIEM endpoint and retention window.

Link to checklist and editable MAP: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD-example
Please add any infra constraints in the shared doc so we can bake them into the MAP.

See you tomorrow — Priyom
